messages:
Priya (Support): Customer reports SSE stream disconnects mid-response during an OTA update on Android. Partial JSON arrives, then immediate EOF. Device: Pixel 6, Android 13, app v3.2.1. They can repro ~80% of attempts. Logs attached.

Mike (Eng): Do we have server-side logs for that session id? Is it a 4xx/5xx or just connection teardown? :thinking:

Priya (Support): Server log shows 200 then connection closed. Client log shows 'read failed: Connection reset by peer'. No 401 or 503. Session id: sess-9f4b. I pasted snippets below from customer-provided logs.

Priya (Support): ```
REQUEST: POST /v1/stream
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>, X-Client-Version: 3.2.1
RESPONSE: 200 OK
data: {"delta":"hello"}
...
read failed: Connection reset by peer
stack: okhttp3.internal.http2.StreamResetException
```

Anna (Client SDK): OTA = over-the-air update? If the OS upgrades or the app install flow restarts the process, Android will SIGKILL the process and the socket doesn't get a clean FIN. Device NAT / carrier often emits RST. Our SDK default keepalive interval is 15s; if the process is killed mid-chunk there is no graceful close. Recommend either: pause streaming before triggering OTA or use a foreground service to protect socket.

Dan (SRE): That matches RST behavior. From server TCP stack we see a RST from client side for that connection window (no FIN). We'll add logging to capture RST vs FIN so we can distinguish client-initiated resets vs server timeouts. Current idle timeout is 60s on the edge - not likely the cause if the client actively RSTs mid-stream.

Mike (Eng): Two immediate mitigations: 1) Client: ensure SDK sends an application-level 'close' event before the updater starts, or checkpoint responses so partial outputs can be resumed. 2) Server: mark these sessions in logs and emit a specific metric (client_rst_midstream) so we can track frequency by client version and platform.

Priya (Support): Customer provided repro steps: 1) Start a long SSE stream (server generates ~400 tokens). 2) Trigger OTA update from in-app remote config -> shows 'install now'. 3) Choose 'Install' while stream running. 4) App is restarted by OS, stream ends with EOF and only partial data received. 5) Reconnect resumes new session, but previous session was truncated.

Anna (Client SDK): Quick code snippet customers can add to reduce impact: use onBeforeInstall hook -> call streamClient.send("__CLIENT_CLOSE__") then close socket; onResume call reconnect and fetch missing tokens. Example: ```
// pseudo
streamClient.onBeforeUpdate(() => { streamClient.emitClose(); streamClient.close(); });
```

Jess (Billing): Heads up re: billing - partial output is billable per our per-token policy. If customers are concerned we can do manual review; please include session ids and timestamps when escalating.

Priya (Support): I asked customer for tcpdump and device-level network logs, plus whether background restrictions are enabled. They've sent packet capture showing TCP RST from device IP immediately after the last SSE chunk. Attaching anonymized pcap.

Dan (SRE): Action items for Eng/SRE: - Add metric client_rst_midstream (tag by sdk_version, os, device) - Add log field tcp_close_type: FIN|RST to session logs - Instrument edge to surface RST rate in Console per-route.

Mike (Eng): I'll file ESCALATION-3421 to track server-side metrics + console surface. Anna, can you add a recommended SDK pattern to docs: "pause-before-upgrade" and mention foreground service option?

Anna (Client SDK): Yes, will add sample and recommend a graceful close hook. I'll include Kotlin snippet and note that if upgrade can't be delayed, clients should tolerate chunked resumptions or fetch missing tokens on reconnect.

Priya (Support): Customer is happy to implement client-side change if we provide a suggested flow. I'll send them the snippet and keep this thread updated. For now setting P1->P2 (customer impact moderate but reproducible). :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Ticket ESCALATION-3421 created and linked to sess-9f4b.

Mike (Eng): Longer-term: consider server-side "session checkpointing" to allow resume from last acked chunk for long-running streams — not trivial but reduces partial-output impact for OTA-like interruptions.

Priya (Support): Thanks all — I'll follow up with customer on receipt of SDK snippet and collect the tcpdump details for the eng ticket.

Dan (SRE): Also FYI: we'll push a small observability change this week to make RST vs FIN visible in session logs. Should help triage if this shows up in other accounts.

Priya (Support): Closing loop once customer confirms.
